spec.claim_summary: RSI and MACD bullish divergences and bearish divergences are claimed to predict profitable moves with over 85% and 90% probability.

claimed.other: Instances of Bearish Divergences (Red Arrows) 17 instances, probability of profitability > 90%

assumptions: Asset not named in claim text; BTCUSDT chosen as most natural reading because the page is about BTC.
Timeframe not stated; 1d chosen as most natural reading for a divergence idea.
Bullish divergence formalized as close below prior N-bar low while RSI and MACD line are above their N-bar minima, N=20.
RSI length 14 and MACD fast 12 slow 26 signal 9 are indicator usual defaults; claim gives no settings.
Blue ascending arrows interpreted as indicators not making new lows alongside price, i.e. divergence.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: exact proprietary blue/green/red arrow detection and pivot-matching logic was left out; approximated with new-low versus indicator-minimum rule.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim asserts both bullish/long divergences and bearish/short divergences but ClaimSpec direction allows only one side per spec; this spec tests the bullish/long side with 29 instances as the closest testable core, the bearish/short side with 17 instances requires a separate mirrored short spec and is omitted here.
No exit stated; max_hold_bars 10 used as most common reading for a divergence reversal setup.
